description: Additional CNPJ lookup with prepared public records and an attempted CNIA source check during the request. Set cnia_atual=true when that check is required: source failure returns 503 without charging or using a previous record. Without this requirement, the last stored CNIA may be returned; read conferidoEm. Select topics to load only the needed blocks. The available free allowance comes before lookup balance or per-call payment. The service checks the company and its headquarters when needed, parses the TCU response and joins it to the prepared company data. This is a source check, not an issued official certificate. Without cnia_atual=true, an older CNIA can be returned; inspect conferidoEm. An unavailable required check does not support a clean conclusion.

cnia_atual.description: Require a CNIA source check during this request. If it fails, return 503 without charging or using a previous record. When selecting topics, include sancoes.

temas.description: Comma-separated topics: dados, contagens, socios, sancoes, fiscal, divida, obras, trabalho, ibama, contratos, pep, vendas, campanhas, prefeituras, sicaf, aeronaves, fundos, rntrc, bndes, registros; todos. Omit for the full record. Basic company data always stays. contagens adds a contagens object with only the record counts (socios, pep, sancoes, fiscal, socioambiental, governo, registros). Unrequested blocks are omitted; null means unchecked. Personal data remains masked.
